incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in toolcall 5xxs on /v1/generate (svc=inference-runtime). KV cache eviction rate up 8x; continuous-batching fragmentations increasing. Pager: oncall=morgan. Correlated tag: schema=func_call
morgan: Acknowledged. I'm jumping on it. Paging @jess for runtime, @owen for model/prefetch logic. Quick snapshot: 95p latency -> 1.8s (norm ~250ms), toolcall 5xx ~2.3%, active KV keys up 7.6x in last 10m.
jess: On it. Pulling logs from the runtime. I see a bunch of batch break events with reason="schema_ejection" and immediate kv evict entries. Example snippet:
```
[2026-11-03T14:02:11Z] BATCH_END id=abc123 reason=schema_ejection size=1; KV_EVICT count=1800; PREFETCH_DROP=true
```
ow looking for the request pattern.
owen: I think this ties to the structured function/toolcall prefetch path we pushed last week. There were changes to prefetch that eagerly materialize tool outputs into KV under unique keys (per tool metadata + call args). If structured outputs have variable shapes (arrays, nested objects), key cardinality explodes and fragments batches.
tariq: Customer impact check: CS shows three distinct production customers hitting timeouts ~14:00-14:10 UTC. Nina, can you paste ticket refs?
nina: Tickets: #CS-4481, #CS-4483, #CS-4490. Customers report request hangs then 504s. I forwarded stack traces to Prod-Support channel.
morgan: OK. Short-term mitigations we can roll right now:
- disable function prefetching route-wide for affected model variants (safe fallback to on-demand)
- lower batching.max_batch_tokens from 4096 -> 2048 and reduce batch.window_ms from 20 -> 5 to reduce long-running batches getting ejected
- add a temporary filter to treat schema=func_call as non-prefetchable
Jess/Owen: can you confirm risk of each? If safe we do immediate hotfix.
jess: Disabling prefetch is low-risk (fallbacks exist). Changing max_batch_tokens will reduce throughput but should lower KV pressure. I recommend doing both.
owen: Agreed. Also add a quick guard to avoid including full tool output in the cache key — strip `tool.response.body` from key computation until we have a stable schema.
morgan: I'll execute the config change as a canary on us-east-1 first.

Command (internal):
```
redwoodctl config set --env us-east-1 --route /v1/generate \
  '{"prefetch": false, "batching": {"max_batch_tokens": 2048, "window_ms": 5}}'
```
Rolling to 10% of runtime fleet now.
jess: Monitoring logs. Applying key-strip guard as a hotpatch to the runtime (small code flip):
```
# runtime: cache_key_builder
if schema == 'func_call':
    exclude_fields += ['tool.response.body']
```
Apply and rolling.

sre-bot: Detected config change by morgan. Canary rollout started. Noting deploy id=deploy-20261103-17
sre-bot: Metric update (2m): KV eviction rate down 63% on canary hosts; batch fragment events reduced; 95p latency on canary ~420ms.
morgan: Canary looks good. Increasing rollout to 60% and notifying support teams to watch for regressions.
nina: CS updated customers with temporary mitigation and ETA for full roll backif needed. They're seeing improved responses for some requests.
tariq: Any regressions to note (semantic/regression in tool outputs)? We should check evals for structured outputs.
owen: So far no function call failures introduced. Prefetch being off means slightly higher per-request compute for toolcalls but avoids KV churn.

incident-bot: Pager annotated: mitigation-in-progress. Incident severity remains P2. Created incident page: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-1103-01
morgan: Preparing handoff to next on-call @owen in 30m. Notes: root cause suspected = excessive cache key cardinality from eager prefetching of variable structured tool outputs -> batch fragmentation -> KV evictions -> higher lat/5xx. Mitigation applied: prefetch disabled; cache-key guard; reduced batch sizes. Follow-ups: full postmortem, add unit tests for cache key determinism, and consider adaptive prefetch heuristics.
owen: Taking handoff at 1839001399. I'll keep monitoring and own the postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Final metric snapshot at handoff: global KV eviction rate down 48% vs peak; cluster 95p latency reduced to 360-480ms depending on region.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed for active paging; follow-up tasks created: TICKET-9123 (postmortem), TICKET-9124 (cache-key tests), TICKET-9125 (prefetch flag per-route).
